landing.faq_consultation_cost_a: Consultation fees depend on the doctor and service type. You can see the fee before booking or starting an instant consultation.
landing.faq_medicine_home_q: Can I receive medicine at home?
landing.faq_medicine_home_a: Yes. Prescriptions can be sent to registered pharmacies, and delivery availability depends on the pharmacy and your location.
landing.faq_prescriptions_a: Digital prescriptions issued through MediConnect can be shared with participating pharmacies for fulfillment.
landing.faq_medication_time_q: How long does it take to receive medication?
landing.faq_medication_time_a: Delivery time varies by pharmacy, stock availability, and distance. The pharmacy confirms the expected time after receiving your request.
landing.faq_specialists_a: Yes. You can browse available specialists and book a scheduled appointment or choose an available instant consultation doctor.
landing.testimonial_1: I consulted a doctor without leaving home and received my prescription in minutes.
landing.testimonial_2: Medication was delivered the same day. Very convenient!
landing.testimonial_3: The appointment was easy to book and the doctor explained everything clearly.
landing.testimonial_4: I received my digital prescription immediately after the consultation.
landing.testimonial_5: The platform helped me consult quickly while I was at work.
landing.testimonial_6: Finding care and getting medicine delivered felt simple and safe.
